newsitem.title: FRANCE: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI AND GOTTI WITHDRAW FROM TOUR DE FRANCE.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-CIPOLLINI AND GOTTI WITHDRAW FROM TOUR DE FRANCE.

text.p: Italians Mario Cipollini and Ivan Gotti pulled out of the Tour de France on Saturday with injuries.
Cipollini, who won the first two stages and wore the yellow jersey for four days, stopped after 25 kms of the 194-km seventh stage because of a knee injury sustained in a mass fall on Friday.
The 30-year-old sprinter from Toscane has never yet completed the Tour de France in five attempts.

Gotti, winner of the Giro d'Italia and one of the most promising Italians for the coming mountain stages, suffered a neck injury in another mass fall on Friday and did not appear at the start on Saturday.
